dishes.name: Paneer Tikka
dishes.description: Soft paneer marinated in aromatic spices and grilled to perfection.
dishes.long: Thick cubes of fresh malai paneer rested overnight in hung curd, Kashmiri chilli and roasted gram flour, then skewered with peppers and onion and finished over live charcoal until the edges char.

dishes.name: Veg Seekh Kebab
dishes.description: Minced garden vegetables and herbs, skewered and char-grilled.
dishes.long: Carrot, beans and peas hand-minced with roasted cashew and green chilli, wrapped around the skewer and cooked till smoky.

dishes.name: Hara Bhara Kebab
dishes.description: Spinach, green peas and potato patties, crisp outside and soft within.
dishes.long: A gentle kebab built on blanched spinach and sweet green peas, bound with potato and pan-seared in ghee until golden.

dishes.name: Crispy Corn
dishes.description: Golden fried sweet corn tossed with chilli, garlic and curry leaf.
dishes.long: Sweet corn kernels dusted in rice flour, fried till they crackle, then tossed in a hot wok with garlic, curry leaf and a squeeze of lime.

dishes.name: Tandoori Mushroom
dishes.description: Button mushrooms in a creamy tandoori marinade, smoked over charcoal.
dishes.long: Whole button mushrooms marinated in cheese, cream and white pepper, skewered and kissed by the tandoor for a soft, smoky bite.

dishes.name: Chicken Tikka
dishes.description: Boneless chicken thigh, marinated twice and grilled over charcoal.
dishes.long: Thigh pieces marinated first in lemon and ginger-garlic, then in spiced hung curd, skewered and cooked in the clay oven till the edges catch colour.

dishes.name: Chicken Seekh Kebab
dishes.description: Hand-minced chicken with green chilli and coriander on the skewer.
dishes.long: Coarsely minced chicken worked with onion, fresh coriander and a touch of garam masala, shaped on iron skewers and grilled till juicy.

dishes.name: Amritsari Fish Fry
dishes.description: Basa fillets in an ajwain-spiked gram flour batter, fried crisp.
dishes.long: The Amritsar classic — fish steeped in carom seed, chilli and gram flour, fried till shatteringly crisp and finished with chaat masala.

dishes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
dishes.description: Paneer in a silky tomato-cashew gravy finished with white butter.
dishes.long: Ripe tomatoes cooked down for hours with cashew and whole spice, blended smooth, then loosened with cream and Amritsari white butter before the paneer goes in.

dishes.name: Kadai Paneer
dishes.description: Paneer and peppers tossed with freshly pounded kadai masala.
dishes.long: Coriander seed and dry red chilli pounded to order, bloomed in ghee with onion and pepper, then folded around paneer in a blazing iron kadai.

dishes.name: Dal Makhani
dishes.description: Black urad simmered overnight with butter, cream and tomato.
dishes.long: Whole black lentils soaked for a day and cooked for twelve hours over a low flame, stirred every half hour, finished with white butter and a hint of smoke.

dishes.name: Palak Paneer
dishes.description: Fresh spinach purée with soft paneer and a garlic tempering.
dishes.long: Spinach blanched and shocked to keep it green, blended coarse, then tempered with garlic, cumin and ginger before the paneer is folded through.

dishes.name: Chole Amritsari
dishes.description: Dark, tangy chickpeas cooked the way Amritsar does it.
dishes.long: Kabuli chana simmered with tea leaves for colour, then finished with anardana, ajwain and a fierce ginger julienne. The only correct partner for our kulcha.

dishes.name: Butter Chicken
dishes.description: Tandoori chicken in a velvety makhani gravy with white butter.
dishes.long: Chicken tikka pulled off the skewer and rested in a makhani gravy of slow-cooked tomato, cashew, cream and a knob of white butter, finished with crushed kasuri methi.

dishes.name: Chicken Curry
dishes.description: Home-style chicken curry with onion, tomato and whole spices.
dishes.long: Bone-in chicken browned with bay leaf and black cardamom, then cooked down in an onion-tomato masala until the oil separates.

dishes.name: Mutton Rogan Josh
dishes.description: Tender mutton in a deep red Kashmiri gravy.
dishes.long: Shoulder cuts braised low and slow with Kashmiri chilli, fennel and dry ginger until the meat gives way at the touch of a spoon.

dishes.name: Dhaba Egg Curry
dishes.description: Boiled eggs in a robust highway-dhaba masala.
dishes.long: Eggs fried in the masala so the spices cling, then simmered in a punchy onion-tomato gravy the way every good highway dhaba does it.

dishes.name: Amritsari Kulcha
dishes.description: Our signature stuffed kulcha, crisped in the tandoor and drowned in butter.
dishes.long: The dish we are named for. A layered maida dough stuffed with spiced potato and paneer, slapped onto the tandoor wall, cracked open at the table and finished with white butter. Served with chole and imli chutney.

dishes.name: Butter Naan
dishes.description: Soft tandoori naan brushed generously with butter.
dishes.long: Leavened dough stretched by hand and baked against the clay wall, then brushed with melted butter as it comes off the skewer.

dishes.name: Garlic Naan
dishes.description: Naan studded with fresh garlic and coriander.
dishes.long: Chopped garlic and coriander pressed into the dough before it hits the tandoor, so the garlic toasts rather than burns.

dishes.name: Tandoori Roti
dishes.description: Whole wheat roti baked in the clay oven.
dishes.long: Simple atta dough, no oil, baked till it puffs and blisters. Ask for it butter-free and it is entirely plant-based.

dishes.name: Lachha Paratha
dishes.description: Layered whole wheat paratha, flaky right through.
dishes.long: Dough rolled, oiled, coiled and rolled again to build dozens of layers that pull apart in ribbons.

dishes.name: Cheese Naan
dishes.description: Naan stuffed with a molten three-cheese filling.
dishes.long: Mozzarella, processed cheese and a little cheddar sealed inside the dough so it stretches when you tear it.

dishes.name: Veg Biryani
dishes.description: Dum-cooked basmati with seasonal vegetables and fried onion.
dishes.long: Vegetables layered with half-cooked basmati, saffron milk and birista, sealed with dough and finished on dum so the steam does the work.

dishes.name: Chicken Biryani
dishes.description: Long-grain basmati and marinated chicken, sealed and cooked on dum.
dishes.long: Chicken marinated in curd and whole spice, layered raw with parboiled basmati and cooked on dum so every grain takes the flavour. Served with burhani raita and salan.

dishes.name: Mutton Biryani
dishes.description: Slow-cooked mutton biryani with saffron and fried onion.
dishes.long: Mutton braised until tender before it meets the rice, then layered with saffron milk, mint and birista and sealed for the final dum.

dishes.name: Jeera Rice
dishes.description: Basmati tempered with cumin and ghee.
dishes.long: Steamed basmati finished with cumin bloomed in ghee — the quiet partner to a heavy gravy.

dishes.name: Dal Khichdi
dishes.description: Comforting rice and lentils with a ghee tadka.
dishes.long: Moong dal and rice cooked soft together, finished with a ghee tadka of cumin, garlic and hing.

dishes.name: Muchhad Veg Thali
dishes.description: Two gravies, dal, rice, breads, salad, papad and dessert.
dishes.long: The full dhaba spread on a single steel plate: paneer gravy, seasonal sabzi, dal makhani, jeera rice, two tandoori breads, salad, papad, raita and a sweet.

dishes.name: Muchhad Non-Veg Thali
dishes.description: Butter chicken, chicken curry, dal, rice, breads and dessert.
dishes.long: Butter chicken and a home-style chicken curry with dal, jeera rice, two tandoori breads, salad, papad and a sweet to close.

dishes.name: Mini Thali
dishes.description: A lighter plate — one gravy, dal, rice, two rotis and salad.
dishes.long: For a quick lunch: one seasonal gravy, dal, jeera rice, two tandoori rotis, salad and papad.

dishes.name: Masala Papad
dishes.description: Roasted papad topped with onion, tomato and chaat masala.
dishes.long: Crisp papad crowned with finely chopped onion, tomato, green chilli and a shower of chaat masala.

dishes.name: Boondi Raita
dishes.description: Whisked curd with crisp boondi and roasted cumin.
dishes.long: Fresh curd whisked smooth, seasoned with roasted cumin and black salt, finished with boondi soaked just enough to soften.

dishes.name: Green Salad
dishes.description: Cucumber, tomato, onion and carrot with lemon.
dishes.long: Cut to order and served cold with lemon wedges and a pinch of black salt.

dishes.name: Dahi Pyaaz
dishes.description: Chilled curd with sliced onion and green chilli.
dishes.long: The dhaba staple — thick curd, sliced onion, slit green chilli and a sprinkle of salt.

dishes.name: Gulab Jamun
dishes.description: Warm khoya dumplings soaked in cardamom syrup.
dishes.long: Khoya dumplings fried slow so they cook through, then rested in a light cardamom and rose syrup. Served warm, two to a bowl.

dishes.name: Rasmalai
dishes.description: Chilled cottage cheese discs in saffron-pistachio milk.
dishes.long: Soft chenna discs simmered and then chilled overnight in reduced milk scented with saffron, finished with slivered pistachio.

dishes.name: Brownie Sizzler
dishes.description: Warm chocolate brownie, vanilla ice cream, hot chocolate sauce.
dishes.long: A dense chocolate brownie on a hot cast-iron plate, topped with vanilla and drowned in chocolate sauce at the table.

dishes.name: Gajar Halwa
dishes.description: Slow-cooked carrot halwa with ghee, khoya and almond.
dishes.long: Red carrots grated by hand and cooked down in full-fat milk for hours, finished with ghee, khoya and toasted almond. Seasonal.

dishes.name: Ice Cream
dishes.description: Vanilla, chocolate or seasonal kulfi.
dishes.long: Two scoops of your chosen flavour, or a slab of our cardamom-pistachio kulfi.

dishes.name: Punjabi Lassi
dishes.description: Thick sweet lassi in a steel glass, topped with malai.
dishes.long: Set curd churned by hand with sugar and a little cream, poured tall and crowned with a spoon of malai.

dishes.name: Masala Chaas
dishes.description: Spiced buttermilk with cumin, ginger and curry leaf.
dishes.long: Thin buttermilk shaken with roasted cumin, ginger, green chilli and a curry leaf, served cold.

dishes.name: Fresh Lime Soda
dishes.description: Lime, soda and your choice of sweet or salted.
dishes.long: Fresh lime pressed to order over ice, topped with chilled soda.

dishes.name: Cold Coffee
dishes.description: Blended cold coffee with ice cream on top.
dishes.long: Strong coffee blended with chilled milk and a scoop of vanilla, served frothy.

dishes.name: Fresh Juices
dishes.description: Seasonal fruit, pressed to order.
dishes.long: Whatever is in season — orange, watermelon, pineapple or mosambi — pressed when you order it, no added sugar.

dishes.name: Kadak Masala Chai
dishes.description: Strong dhaba chai boiled with ginger and cardamom.
dishes.long: Boiled long the way it should be, with fresh ginger, cardamom and plenty of milk. Served in a kulhad.

dishes.name: Soft Drinks
dishes.description: Chilled bottled soft drinks.
dishes.long: A chilled bottle of the usual suspects.
